records.rationale: Reviewed final ACK capability guard: scans planes for color_pipeline_property and returns EOPNOTSUPP when none exists, avoiding hiding legacy encoding/range properties. ACK virtio-gpu/VKMS therefore reject this capability too. Retain native EINVAL for the unknown capability, a documented errno difference; neither kernel activates pipeline mode on these target drivers. Local drm_hwcomposer checks nonzero failure without distinguishing these errno values. Native property visibility remains, so the regression fixed here is not imported.

records.rationale: Retain all three DRM_RENDER_ALLOW entries for create/map/destroy dumb buffers. Goldfish packages minigbm; its pinned virtgpu_virgl.c explicitly routes the non-3D path through drv_dumb_bo_create_ex/destroy/map, which issue these ioctls. This deliberately relaxes native render-client permission rejection and expands allocation/mapping attack surface for processes able to open render nodes. Preserve whole native dumb-buffer validation (zero dimensions, overflow, output initialization), per-file handle mapping/deletion and all other ioctl privilege flags. It does not grant DRM master/modesetting permission. Current ioctl source equals native after replacing exactly these three flags with zero. Build165 compiled the corresponding virtio-gpu module; no runtime ioctl test or allocation-safety proof is claimed.

records.rationale: Retain GPL export of the current native drm_mode_convert_to_umode implementation for rebuilt display modules. Preserve native strscpy_pad and all native mode fields/validation; the historical strncpy body is not restored. The result commit also exports the opposite-direction native helper under its separate review. This is a generic source customization interface for configured DRM, with exact optional SDK module usage unconfirmed. Modules are trusted kernel code; exporting a helper is not a new userspace ioctl or preservation of historical binary KMI.
